claims.evidence: All 44 RAW files in PRIDE file list, each claimed once.
PRIDE sample protocol: U2OS cells expressing EGFP, GRAMD1C-EGFP or GRAMD1C(delta-GRAM)-EGFP; siNC/siGRAMD1C U2OS. Age 15Y/female/osteosarcoma/bone from Cellosaurus, not the deposit.

claims.value: H1813-H1823 EGFP; H1825-H1833 GRAMD1C-EGFP; H2116-H2122 GRAMD1C-delta-GRAM-EGFP
claims.evidence: INFERRED. proteinGroups.txt experiment names 1813..2122 match H files (mqpar.xml). GRAMD1C LFQ is ~0 in 1813-1823 and 2116-2120, 900-2300 (x1e6) in 1825-1833, low in 2122; correlation clusters agree with these three groups. No deposited mapping file.
EVo_mqpar.xml lists 24 EP files as experiments 1-24 with no condition names; paper gives no run mapping.
PRIDE instrument MS:1002523; paper: Easy nLC1000 coupled to QExactive HF. EP file path 'ORBITRAP HF Evosep'.
Protocol: Trypsin without proline restriction (mqpar Trypsin/P), 2 missed cleavages. reconcile's cleavage_agent_unsupported flag is a false positive on capitalisation/wording.
mainSearchTol 4.5 in both mqpar files (text says 6 ppm; deposited parameter used).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term variable

limitations: Condition-to-file mapping is inferred (H runs from GRAMD1C abundance/correlation; EP runs undocumented).
Unbalanced H groups (6/5/4) could not be confirmed against a deposited design table.

EP runs (24 searched in EVo_mqpar.xml + 5 unsearched: EP428/433/438/443/448) are labelled U2OS with factor 'not available'; likely siNC/siGRAMD1C proteome and other experiments, and the unsearched ones may be QC runs.
Paper is a bioRxiv preprint; methods describe only the Easy-nLC1000 interactome workflow, not the Evosep runs.
Evosep LC method not captured; fragment tolerance is the MaxQuant FTMS default.
